units.source_text: “燕子！燕子！”名人驻足仰望苍穹，用嘶哑的声音在咽喉里嘟哝了一句。

en.t: “Swallows! Swallows!” The master stopped and looked up at the sky, muttering a word deep in his throat in a hoarse voice.

units.source_text: 原来他已经走到一块大岩石前，岩石上面刻有“明治大帝驻辇御座所基石”的字样。

en.t: He had in fact already come to a large rock, on which were carved the words “Foundation Stone of the Site Where the Meiji Emperor Stopped His Carriage and Sat.”

units.source_text: 在基石上伸展枝梢的百日红还没开花。

en.t: The crape myrtle spreading its branches over the foundation stone had not yet bloomed.

units.source_text: 奈良屋是当年诸侯所住的驿站旅店。

en.t: Nara-ya was once a post-station inn where feudal lords stayed.
